steps.what: Document accident facts, unscheduled stops and delays against original records
Prepare reports from verified facts without adding unconfirmed causes

loop.purpose: Draft the account into the report structure
loop.input: Verified event brief and approved blank report
loop.output: Draft with source links and explicit unknowns
loop.check: Conductor compares sequence, attribution, uncertainty and stated causes to original observations and records
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved meaning returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed fields can be copied, but the event account requires language interpretation

steps.what: Check final reports and approve the internal event record

tasks.design: Use the {OPS_SYSTEM} event record and a verified account to prefill fields in {DOCS}. A bounded draft preserves unknown causes, and the conductor approves the final internal version.
tasks.previous_blocker: An event account and train records must be reconciled before a report can be written.
tasks.enabler_now: Field mapping and bounded text drafting can support an existing report form.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish direct observations, reported statements and uncertain causes.
tasks.human_edge: Accept responsibility for what the report actually asserts.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft writing; event verification and reporting authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the evidence supporting an incident account

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: report fields can be copied and a source-bounded account drafted, but the local saving remains unmeasured.
The digest describes Dutch ILT telephone and digital incident reporting obligations; internal draft approval does not replace those reporting steps.

assumptions: Boundary is the conductor's internal report preparation, excluding emergency response, investigation and regulator submission; those existing duties are unchanged.

In s1 the conductor produces train identifier, event time and time zone, location, observed event, delay duration, actions, source references and explicitly unknown causes. Time for reading logs, capture and resolving missing facts remains in the full 35%; absent structured logs require manual capture there.
The report loop only consumes the s1 brief; it cannot infer causes or complete missing observations. Existing train-log production remains outside this task and gains no claimed saving.
Test native forms and field mapping before custom integration. No automatic external filing or performance monitoring is introduced.
unknowns: Existing report automation and required report fields
Local reporting responsibilities and applicable national procedure
research_questions: Does source comparison consume the drafting time saved on ambiguous incident accounts?

incremental.description: Template checks and recurring exception review

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report text, fields, evidence references, event identifier and recipient recorded after corrections; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+26+25=86; gross=14, focal incremental=6, net=8. Conservative 0-4 assumes existing prefilling or lengthy fact correction removes much of the proposed drafting gain; no response or filing time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record journey and passenger transaction details

steps.what: Capture departure and arrival times, messages and passenger transaction facts
Copy verified times, tickets, revenue and accommodations into the journey record
Reconcile journey totals and approve the completed record

tasks.design: Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} to compile already captured journey entries into the existing record. Keep initial capture, message interpretation, reconciliation and final approval with the conductor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts captured during a journey may be copied again into a separate summary.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views and field mapping can reuse captured values.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve missing transactions, ambiguous messages and cash discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when recorded entries do not represent what happened.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate copying where it exists; passenger service and reconciliation remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Relevant service categories and privacy limits

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic compilation can reuse verified journey entries, but this duplicate-copy baseline must be confirmed locally.

assumptions: Boundary covers recording and compilation, excluding ticket sale, cash handling and delivery of passenger accommodations; no saving is assigned to those services.

The conductor produces journey identifier, event type, observed time and time zone, message text, ticket reference, currency and amount, accommodation request and destination during s1. Manual capture and message clarification retain the full 45%; no free transaction or structured destination flag is assumed.
s2 uses only the s1 entries and fails closed on missing identifiers or incompatible totals; the conductor resolves these manually in s3. Existing automatic transaction capture earns no labour saving.
Test native record configuration before custom code. If the summary is already automatic, there is no duplicate-copy saving and the proposal is not adopted.
unknowns: Whether separate summary copying actually occurs
Export fields and access to transaction records
research_questions: Can a native journey view replace duplicate copying while retaining exception traceability?

incremental.description: Mapping checks and recurring exception review

approvals.approved_version: Exact journey identifier, entry set, totals, messages, destinations and accommodation details reviewed before recording; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+0+25=70; gross=30, incremental=7, net=23. Range 0-10 allows for an already automatic summary or many unstructured journey entries; collection and service time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reuse verified records while retaining incident accountability and journey reconciliation.
reach: Provide safety officers with attributed event accounts and operations clerks with reconciled journey records.
role.ambitious_version: A conductor who spends less time copying and keeps responsibility for factual records.
